program.source: export function evaluate({ inputs, time }) { const launchSpeed = inputs.launchSpeed; const gravity = inputs.gravity; const apexTime = launchSpeed / gravity; const apexHeight = (launchSpeed * launchSpeed) / (2 * gravity); const t = time; const tossedVelocity = launchSpeed - gravity * t; const tossedAcceleration = -gravity; const tossedHeight = launchSpeed * t - 0.5 * gravity * t * t; const isHeld = t <= apexTime; const dropVelocity = isHeld ? 0 : -gravity * (t - apexTime); const dropAcceleration = isHeld ? 0 : -gravity; const dropHeight = isHeld ? apexHeight : tossedHeight; let tossState = "At launch"; if (t > 0 && t < apexTime) tossState = "Rising"; else if (Math.abs(t - apexTime) < 0.02) tossState = "At the top"; else if (t > apexTime && tossedHeight > 0) tossState = "Falling"; else if (t >= apexTime && tossedHeight <= 0) tossState = "At launch height"; let dropState = "Held in place"; if (Math.abs(t - apexTime) < 0.02) dropState = "Just released"; else if (t > apexTime && dropHeight > 0) dropState = "Falling together"; else if (t >= apexTime && dropHeight <= 0) dropState = "At launch height"; const scaleY = 120; const originY = 320; const tossedY = originY - tossedHeight * scaleY; const dropY = originY - dropHeight * scaleY; const laneToss = sdk.panel({x: 40, y: 50, w: 260, h: 340, title: "Toss lane", state: tossState, id: "lane.toss"}); const laneDrop = sdk.panel({x: 340, y: 50, w: 260, h: 340, title: "Drop lane", state: dropState, id: "lane.drop"}); const ballToss = sdk.circle("ball.toss", 170, tossedY, 28, {role: "observed"}); const ballDrop = sdk.circle("ball.drop", 470, dropY, 28, {role: "observed"}); const vecVToss = sdk.vector("vec.v.toss", {x: 140, y: tossedY}, {value: tossedVelocity, direction: "up"}, {scale: 15, label: "v"}); const vecAToss = sdk.vector("vec.a.toss", {x: 200, y: tossedY}, {value: tossedAcceleration, direction: "up"}, {scale: 15, label: "a"}); const vecVDrop = sdk.vector("vec.v.drop", {x: 440, y: dropY}, {value: dropVelocity, direction: "up"}, {scale: 15, label: "v"}); const vecADrop = sdk.vector("vec.a.drop", {x: 500, y: dropY}, {value: dropAcceleration, direction: "up"}, {scale: 15, label: "a"}); const calloutToss = sdk.callout(190, tossedY - 30, ["v: " + sdk.format(tossedVelocity, 2) + " m/s", "a: " + sdk.format(tossedAcceleration, 1) + " m/s^2"], {id: "callout.toss"}); const calloutDrop = sdk.callout(490, dropY - 30, ["v: " + sdk.format(dropVelocity, 2) + " m/s", "a: " + sdk.format(dropAcceleration, 1) + " m/s^2"], {id: "callout.drop"}); const axisToss = sdk.axis("axis.toss", {x: 60, y: originY, length: 240, orientation: "y", min: 0, max: 2.2, label: "Height", unit: "m"}); const axisDrop = sdk.axis("axis.drop", {x: 360, y: originY, length: 240, orientation: "y", min: 0, max: 2.2, label: "Height", unit: "m"}); const objects = [...laneToss, ...laneDrop, axisToss, axisDrop, ballToss, ballDrop, ...vecVToss, ...vecAToss, ...vecVDrop, ...vecADrop, ...calloutToss, ...calloutDrop]; return {frame: {width: 640, height: 420, objects, readouts: [{id: "tossedVelocity", value: tossedVelocity}, {id: "tossedAcceleration", value: tossedAcceleration}, {id: "dropVelocity", value: dropVelocity}, {id: "dropAcceleration", value: dropAcceleration}]}, quantities: {tossedVelocity, tossedAcceleration, dropVelocity, dropAcceleration, apexTime, apexHeight}}; }

manifest.title: Zero velocity isn’t zero acceleration.
manifest.summary: At the top, velocity is zero for an instant, but gravity keeps changing it: a = -g. The gate releases a second ball at that moment.
manifest.description: Two side-by-side lanes show a tossed ball and a dropped ball. At the top of the toss, velocity is zero while acceleration remains -9.8 m/s^2, and a second ball is released to fall alongside it.
assumptions: No air resistance, the same gravity for both balls, up is positive.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed or gravity, then press Play. At each pause, compare velocity and acceleration.
